ruleDefinitions.name: LSASS Dump Keyword In CommandLine
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "lsass" and ".dmp" in the commandline, which could indicate a potential attempt to dump or create a dump of the lsass process.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass\\\.zip.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass\\\.rar.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Andrew\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Coredump\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*NotLSASS\\\.zip.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass\\_2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsassdump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsassdmp.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*lsass.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*SQLDmpr.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.mdmp.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*nanodump.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*")))
